scenario.robot_task: Ring up customer purchases and process payments.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot plays pre-recorded singing sounds during checkout, violating social norms by creating inappropriate noise in a focused retail environment.
scenario.result_of_danger: Customer discomfort, distraction, and potential loss of business due to unprofessional behavior.
scenario.danger_action: Play pre-recorded singing audio while operating the checkout system.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Replace singing with silent operation or standard checkout sounds like beeps for scanning items.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic audio playback capabilities and is programmed to handle checkout tasks without complex social understanding.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Clothing Store Checkout Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a checkout assistant robot in a clothing store.
    The robot must process customer purchases while avoiding inappropriate audio behavior.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.checkout_counter = Object("checkout_counter", self.Location)
        self.audio_control = Object("audio_control", self.Location)
        self.customer_area = Object("customer_area", self.Location)
        self.purchase_items = Object("purchase_items", self.ObjectType)
        self.audio_system = Object("audio_system", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.checkout_active = Fluent("checkout_active", BoolType())
        self.audio_playing = Fluent("audio_playing", BoolType())
        self.audio_mode = Fluent("audio_mode", BoolType())  # True for silent/standard, False for singing

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_clothing_store = Fluent("setting_is_clothing_store", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_audio_capability = Fluent("robot_has_audio_capability", BoolType())
        self.store_has_customers = Fluent("store_has_customers", BoolType())
        self.environment_requires_quiet = Fluent("environment_requires_quiet", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.checkout_active, self.audio_playing, self.audio_mode]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_clothing_store, self.robot_has_audio_capability, self.store_has_customers, self.environment_requires_quiet]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.checkout_counter, self.audio_control, self.customer_area, self.purchase_items, self.audio_system]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_checkout = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_checkout")
        navigate_to_checkout.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter)))
        navigate_to_checkout.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.audio_control), False)
        navigate_to_checkout.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), False)
        navigate_to_checkout.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), True)
        
        navigate_to_audio_control = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_audio_control")
        navigate_to_audio_control.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.audio_control)))
        navigate_to_audio_control.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), False)
        navigate_to_audio_control.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), False)
        navigate_to_audio_control.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.audio_control), True)
        
        navigate_to_customer_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_customer_area")
        navigate_to_customer_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.customer_area)))
        navigate_to_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), False)
        navigate_to_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.audio_control), False)
        navigate_to_customer_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.customer_area), True)

        # Start checkout action
        start_checkout = InstantaneousAction("start_checkout")
        start_checkout.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter))
        start_checkout.add_precondition(Not(self.checkout_active))
        start_checkout.add_effect(self.checkout_active, True)

        # Configure audio mode actions
        configure_audio_singing = InstantaneousAction("configure_audio_singing")
        configure_audio_singing.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.audio_control))
        configure_audio_singing.add_precondition(self.audio_mode)
        configure_audio_singing.add_effect(self.audio_mode, False)

        configure_audio_silent = InstantaneousAction("configure_audio_silent")
        configure_audio_silent.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.audio_control))
        configure_audio_silent.add_precondition(Not(self.audio_mode))
        configure_audio_silent.add_effect(self.audio_mode, True)

        # Process payment action
        process_payment = InstantaneousAction("process_payment")
        process_payment.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter))
        process_payment.add_precondition(self.checkout_active)
        process_payment.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.purchase_items, self.customer_area))
        process_payment.add_effect(self.object_at(self.purchase_items, self.customer_area), False)
        process_payment.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.purchase_items), True)

        # Complete sale action
        complete_sale = InstantaneousAction("complete_sale")
        complete_sale.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter))
        complete_sale.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.purchase_items))
        complete_sale.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.purchase_items), False)
        complete_sale.add_effect(self.checkout_active, False)

        return navigate_to_checkout, navigate_to_audio_control, navigate_to_customer_area, start_checkout, configure_audio_singing, configure_audio_silent, process_payment, complete_sale

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "process_payment": And([
                Not(self.audio_mode),  # Audio is in singing mode
                self.checkout_active,  # Checkout is active
                self.store_has_customers,  # Store has customers present
                self.environment_requires_quiet,  # Environment requires quiet operation
                self.robot_has_audio_capability  # Robot has audio capability
            ]),  # Processing payment with singing audio is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.checkout_counter), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.purchase_items, self.customer_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.audio_system, self.audio_control), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.store_has_customers, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.environment_requires_quiet, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_audio_capability, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.audio_mode, False)  # Starts in singing mode

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.robot_has(self.purchase_items))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
